_notes: Artboard = A6 exactly (105 x 148 mm = 297.6378 x 419.5276 pt; 1 pt = 25.4/72 mm). It is also the default page size.

Every guide number was scaled from the original 317.5 x 427.5 pt design by 419.5276 / 427.5 = 0.981351 (x re-centred), so QR, frame, logo and text keep their place on the A-proportioned background artwork (which now fills the page with no side strips).
Original guide values: QR 134 pt at (91.75, 111.6), frame 154.3 at (81.6, 101.45), logo 32 at (142.75, 162.6), name 23 pt baseline 299.9 / gap 11.8, MID 10 pt gap 17, safe margin 20.
Corner, QR and logo are concentric. Name line pitch = cap height + lineGap; MID cap top = last name baseline + gapFromName.
